restaurantName: The Fortnum's Bar & Restaurant at The Royal Exchange
address: The Courtyard, The, Royal Exchange, London ,EC3V 3LR
bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2019 - Commended  Treat yourself to Fortnum and Mason's famous Afternoon Tea in the iconic surroundings of The Royal Exchange at the newly opened Fortnum's Bar & Restaurant.  Standing proud in the impressive central courtyard of The Royal Exchange, Fortnum's Bar & Restaurant is the perfect blend of classic and contemporary. They serve up quintessential Afternoon Tea in a stylish, al-fresco setting, allowing guests to indulge themselves whilst soaking up the impressive surroundings of The Royal Exchange. In warmer months, guests can enjoy Afternoon Tea on their new outdoor terrace, next to the grand pillared entrance of The Royal Exchange.  Situated right in the heart of England's buzzing capital, The Royal Exchange is one of London's most historic buildings. It is now home to an unparalleled collection of boutique shops and dining spaces - the perfect place to while away the afternoon.  Their Afternoon Tea menu comprises a delicate array of finger sandwiches, freshly-baked scones and decadent sweets, all served alongside your choice of specially blended Royal Exchange Tea. And if you're feeling fancy, why not upgrade your Afternoon Tea to include a glass of Champagne?  The Fortnum's Bar & Restaurant at The Royal Exhange is conveniently located, just a short walk from Bank Underground Station and within easy reach of some of the city's key attractions including London Bridge and St. Paul's Cathedral.
